fields.label: Country
fields.note: Multi-select in form#job-filter (id l-country); options are populated by the portal, so no values are hard-coded.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: City multi-select (id l-location); the form also publishes a separate 'region' multi-select for state/province.

fields.label: Employment type
fields.note: Multi-select (id l-type). The form also publishes 'wtype' (Fixed Term / Intern (Fixed Term) / Regular), which is a worker type rather than an employment type.

notes: wellsfargojobs.com is Wells Fargo's own server-rendered board (20 cards per page, ?page=N, 'Showing X to Y of Z' counter, RSS alternate at /en/jobs/xml/?rss=true). Search is a plain GET form#job-filter (action /en/jobs/#results, method get) whose control names are the query parameters: search, country, region, location, team, type, wtype and the hidden pagesize=20 — multi-selects send repeated parameters. The same data is served by the site's own XHR GET https://www.wellsfargojobs.com/umbraco/jobboard/CandidateJobs/GetJobs?culture=en. No sort control/parameter is published on the form, so the scraper keeps portal order. The listing host answers 403 to plain curl and only renders for a browser client.
evidence: https://www.wellsfargojobs.com/en/jobs/ (headless Chromium, HTTP 200) -> form#job-filter method=get action=/en/jobs/#results; controls: input[name=search], select[name=country], select[name=region], select[name=location], select[name=team], select[name=type], select[name=wtype], input[name=pagesize][value=20]
https://www.wellsfargojobs.com/umbraco/jobboard/CandidateJobs/GetJobs?culture=en -> XHR the listing page issues for the same board
